players.product: Power Systems division: backup engines and gas engines for prime power at data centres; next-generation engine to replace the Series 4000, targeting the data centre market with increased power density (launch 2028)

quarterly_data.signal: Civil Aerospace H1 2026: operating profit grew to GBP 1.6 billion, a 31% increase year-on-year, with operating margin of 25.3%; OE deliveries of 279 were 18% higher (157 large engines, 122 business aviation); shop visits grew to 712, of which 294 were large engine refurbs (35% higher); large engine flying hours grew to 113% of 2019 levels; net contractual margin improvements were GBP 497 million. CFO: product availability is improving, but product cost inflation remains an industry-wide challenge, especially in rare earths and elementals; based on the current environment, that charge will reduce in 2027 and be gone by 2028.
quarterly_data.figure: Civil operating profit GBP 1.6 billion (+31%), margin 25.3%; 279 OE deliveries; 712 shop visits

quarterly_data.signal: Defence H1 2026: operating profit grew to GBP 522 million, almost 60% higher than last year, with operating margin of 21%; order intake close to GBP 2.5 billion with a book-to-bill ratio of one; order backlog GBP 17.5 billion, equivalent to over three years of revenue, with order cover for the remainder of the year approaching 90%.
quarterly_data.figure: Defence operating profit GBP 522 million, margin 21%; order backlog GBP 17.5 billion
